shared_elements: human figure in profile/frontal schematic form
justification: The only real correspondence is the presence of human figures with raised arms placed beside other linear motifs, which is a near-universal motif and not diagnostic of a shared tradition. A shows a densely filled composition of proportioned, detailed profile figures with a seated figure, offering table and rows of small sign-like symbols, while B shows a single extremely reduced stick figure next to a long undulating serpentine line on an otherwise empty field.
